novel_policies.label: board engineering disciplines represented
novel_policies.quote: The professional members of the board shall be so selected that not more than two of them shall specialize in any one of the five major disciplines of engineering: civil, mining and metallurgical, mechanical, electrical and chemical.

novel_policies.label: board member responsible charge years required
novel_policies.quote: Each professional member shall have been engaged in the practice of the respective profession for at least ten years and shall have been in responsible charge of work for at least five years.

novel_policies.label: code of ethics in statute
novel_policies.quote: It shall be considered unprofessional and inconsistent with honorable and dignified bearing for a person who is a professional engineer, professional land surveyor or professional geologist: To act for the person's client or employer in professional matters otherwise than as a faithful agent or trustee...

novel_policies.label: covers geology
novel_policies.quote: for any person to practice or to offer to practice geology unless he is licensed and registered under the laws of this Commonwealth as a professional geologist.

novel_policies.label: covers land surveying
novel_policies.quote: Practice of Land Surveying means the practice of that branch of the profession of engineering which involves the location, relocation, establishment, reestablishment or retracement of any property line or boundary of any parcel of land...

novel_policies.label: engineer intern certificate available
novel_policies.quote: Engineer Intern means a candidate for licensure as a professional engineer, who has been granted a certificate as an engineer intern after successfully passing the prescribed written examination in fundamental engineering subjects.

novel_policies.label: exemptions from licensure
novel_policies.quote: The practice of engineering, land surveying or geology by officers and employes of the United States Government for the said government.

novel_policies.label: firm practice allowed
novel_policies.quote: it shall be unlawful for any firm or corporation to engage in such practice... unless the directing heads and employes of such firm or corporation in responsible charge of its activities in the practice of such profession are licensed and registered in conformity with the requirements of this act.

novel_policies.label: geologist in training certificate available
novel_policies.quote: Geologist-in-training means a candidate for licensure as a professional geologist who has been granted a certificate as a geologist-in-training after successfully passing the required written examination in fundamental geology subjects.

novel_policies.label: degree level: associate
novel_policies.quote: a diploma of graduation or degree from a technical college approved by the professional engineer section as of satisfactory standing in an engineering-related course of study of not less than 2 years.

novel_policies.label: experience source: none
novel_policies.quote: shall submit evidence satisfactory to the board of the applicant's education, training, and experience

novel_policies.label: houses oversight in a division
novel_policies.quote: There is created within the Department of Commerce the Division of Professional Licensing.

novel_policies.label: multi license reporting required
novel_policies.quote: Any licensee of this Commonwealth who is also licensed to practice engineering, land surveying or geology in any other state, territory or country shall report this information to the board on the biennial renewal application.

novel_policies.label: pdh carryover max units
novel_policies.quote: If a licensee exceeds the requirement in any renewal period, a maximum of twelve PDH units may be carried forward into the subsequent renewal period.

novel_policies.label: pdh units per renewal period
novel_policies.quote: Each licensee shall be required to obtain twenty-four PDH units during the biennial renewal period.

novel_policies.label: postgraduate degree experience credit years max
novel_policies.quote: The board may grant one year of experience credit for each postbaccalaureate engineering degree earned by applicants for licensure, not to exceed two years.

novel_policies.label: responsible charge defined
novel_policies.quote: Responsible Charge means a position that requires initiative, skill and independent judgment, and implies such degree of competence and accountability gained by technical education and experience of a grade and character as is sufficient to qualify an individual to personally and independently engage in and be entrusted with the work involved in the practice of engineering or land surveying.

novel_policies.label: retired status license available
novel_policies.quote: A licensee who lists his occupation as retired on the board-approved renewal form and certifies to the board that he no longer engages in the practice of his licensed profession shall be exempt from the requirement set forth in subsection (a), and the board shall issue him a retired-status license.

novel_policies.label: seal document types
novel_policies.quote: whose name, seal and signature, along with the date of signature, shall be stamped on all plans, specifications, plats and reports issued by such firm or corporation.

novel_policies.label: seal required on documents
novel_policies.quote: Such seal, or a facsimile imprint of same, shall be stamped on all plans, specifications, plats and reports issued by a professional engineer, professional land surveyor or professional geologist.

novel_policies.label: surveyor in training certificate available
novel_policies.quote: Surveyor-in-Training means a candidate for licensure as a professional land surveyor who has been granted a certificate as a surveyor-in-training after successfully passing the prescribed written examination in fundamental land surveying subjects.

novel_policies.label: has advisory board
novel_policies.quote: The Secretary shall appoint a Professional Engineering Board. The Board shall consist of 10 members who shall serve in an advisory capacity to the Secretary.

novel_policies.label: degree level: none
novel_policies.quote: The person has had twelve years of full-time lawful experience in engineering work of a character satisfactory to the board, or part-time experience which the board finds to be the equivalent thereof; and has successfully passed a written examination

novel_policies.label: school approval basis: unspecified
novel_policies.quote: shall submit evidence satisfactory to the board of the applicant's education, training, and experience

novel_policies.label: houses oversight in a department
novel_policies.quote: "Department" means the Department of Financial and Professional Regulation.

novel_policies.label: has covers geology
novel_policies.quote: A state board for engineering, land surveying and geology shall be appointed by the board of regents

does not offer surveyor in training certificate
lacks covers land surveying
